title: Node register row
description: A stage (L3, no parent) or an episode, step or interaction inside a stage (L4). sequence equals the number in the node ID's last segment. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: node_id and journey_id (identity and the journey the node belongs to), node_type, sequence and name (position and meaning), evidence_status (every claim carries provenance; use 'unknown' rather than leaving it blank). parent_node_id is empty for stage-level nodes; actor_goal and evidence_ids may not be known yet.

parent_node_id.description: Node ID minus its last -NN segment; empty for stage-level nodes.

sequence.description: Position among siblings; equals the node ID's last segment.
